mustRead: very long straight bill with a faint upward tilt and a pale base
long dark legs trailing behind in flight
cinnamon breast barred with dark chevrons
why: Strict right-facing lateral walking godwit: long straight bill, both long legs with separate toe fans, folded near wing with primaries over the barred tail, all with clear margins.

observed.tail: barred undertail and dark tail tips under the primaries

limitations: Long-legged mapping: legKnee is the intertarsal joint; thigh owner is the visible tibiotarsus (C215 ostrich convention).
Far wing is not separately visible; far-wing owners are the upper back/primaries edge above the near wing (interpretation, robin convention).
